review_conclusion: All ten proposals are distinct in operative mechanism from the 150 inherited records. Similar governance nouns remain because the same protected domains are intentionally preserved, but no prior mission is merely renamed.
boundary: A collision audit supports preregistration novelty only; it does not establish scientific novelty, patentability, publication priority, or empirical validity.
